dealSummary: Cathedral, a cyber operations startup focused on US military capabilities, raised a $160 million round led by Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia Capital at a $1.4 billion valuation, Reuters reported.
AegisAI, which builds AI agents to defend against phishing attacks, raised a $36 million Series A led by Battery Ventures.
San Francisco-based Paper, the developer of an AI-native creative design platform, raised a $34 million Series A led by Accel and Iconiq.
Singapore-based Ropedia, which builds data infrastructure for physical AI and robotics, raised $30 million in pre-A funding.
Abstract, the developer of a composable security operations platform, raised a $25 million round led by Cheyenne Ventures and AVP.
Transcripta Bio, a biopharma company developing treatments for neurological and neuromuscular diseases, raised $24 million from investors including Mayo Clinic, Omnimed and Jazz Venture Partners.
leadInvestors: Mayo Clinic, Omnimed, Jazz Venture Partners

dealSummary: Elio, which builds AI-native machine sensors, raised a $21 million round led by Innovation Endeavors and Xora.
Trooly, the developer of a platform for conducting consumer research interviews, raised nearly $20 million in seed funding.
San Francisco-based Prosper Medical, which offers AI-powered concierge primary care, raised $16 million led by Fuse.
Telli, a Berlin-based AI startup that helps automate customer-facing operations, raised $15 million in a seed round led by Redalpine.
Neon Commerce, a fintech startup specializing in DTC commerce for the games industry, closed a $13 million Series A from investors including Krafton, Andreessen Horowitz and Renegade Partners.
